Akshay wadhwa

akkiwadhwa1995@gmail.com +919660094123 Ganganagar, RJ

Summary

Experienced Full Stack Developer with a strong background in Python development using Flask and Django, and extensive expertise in modern JavaScript technologies such as Node.js, NestJS, Next.js, React, React Native, Express.js, and MongoDB for building dynamic, scalable web and mobile applications. Highly proﬁcient in React for developing responsive and intuitive front-end interfaces. Skilled in data analysis and visualization with Pandas and Matplotlib, and experienced in automation using Selenium. Adept at web scraping, developing desktop applications with PyQt5, and building both RESTful and GraphQL APIs. Strong foundation in database management using SQL and PostgreSQL.

Experienced with cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Hands-on knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and Nginx for containerization, orchestration, and server conﬁguration. Proﬁcient in version control with Git, and skilled in front-end technologies including JavaScript, jQuery, CSS3, and HTML5. A collaborative team player and problem-solver, passionate about delivering high-performance, maintainable, and production-ready solutions.

Experience

Full Stack Developer AIMLEAP • Banglore, karnataka

02/2023 - Present

Developed and maintained scalable web applications, resulting in a 30% improvement in performance. Developed and maintained scalable, high-performance web applications using Node.js for backend services and Next.js for frontend interfaces, ensuring seamless integration and a smooth user experience across the full stack. Designed and implemented RESTful and GraphQL APIs using NestJS, enabling efﬁcient and secure communication between client-side applications and backend services. Utilized server-side rendering (SSR) and static site generation (SSG) with Next.js to improve page load times, SEO, and overall application performance. Deployed and managed applications on cloud platforms like AWS or DigitalOcean, setting up CI/CD pipelines and ensuring reliable, automated delivery of updates and new features.

Lead Python Developer Go-perceptive • Gurugram

04/2022 - 02/2023

Designed and developed a scalable, enterprise-level web scraping system tailored for Indian e-commerce platforms, enabling automated extraction of pricing, availability, and product metadata across thousands of listings. Engineered robust scraping pipelines using Python, BeautifulSoup, lxml, and Selenium, handling anti-bot mechanisms, dynamic content, and CAPTCHAs. Implemented proxy rotation, user-agent spooﬁng, and throttling strategies to ensure long-term scraper reliability and IP protection. Integrated scraped data with MongoDB and PostgreSQL, supporting real-time analytics and competitive pricing dashboards. Automated scheduled scraping jobs using cron and Celery, processing millions of records daily with minimal downtime.

Lead Python Developer Sataware Technologies • Chennai

04/2019 - 04/2022

Developed and maintained scalable web applications using Django on the backend and React on the frontend, enabling seamless integration of RESTful APIs with dynamic user interfaces.

Designed and implemented reusable, responsive UI components using React, optimizing performance and accessibility across modern browsers and devices. Built robust backends with Django REST Framework, handling complex business logic, secure user authentication, and third-party service integrations. Led full-stack development for internal tools and client projects, leveraging Django, React, and PostgreSQL, signiﬁcantly reducing development turnaround time. Integrated MongoDB and SQL/PostgreSQL databases across microservices and monolithic systems, ensuring optimal data consistency and scalability.

Freelance Developer Freelancer.com

04/2017 - 04/2019

Web Development: Built responsive and dynamic websites using Django, React, and other modern frameworks. Web Scraping: Developed efﬁcient web scraping scripts and solutions using Python libraries like BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, and Selenium. Desktop Application Development: Created robust desktop applications tailored to client needs. Data Science and Data Analysis: Applied data science techniques and tools for insightful data analysis and visualization. Automation: Implemented automation solutions to streamline workﬂows and increase efﬁciency. Achieved a 90%+ client retention rate through consistent delivery of high-quality work and excellent customer service.

Skills

Python, Node.js, ReactJS, Flask/Django, Data Analysis and Visualization, Pandas and Matplotlib, Browser Automation, Selenium, Software Development, pyqt5, Version Control, Git, Data Acquisition, Web Scrapping/Data Mining, SQL and Database, Scripting, API Development, Apache Server, Containerization: Docker, Cloud, AWS, Express.js, Node.js, JavaScript, JQuery, CSS3, HTML 5, English, CI/CD, Postﬁx mail server, MongoDB, React Native

Education

Bachelor's in Computer Applications Jodhpur National University

01/2016

Awards

Team Player Q1 -2024 - Aimleap, Achievement Award for the Flo Project - Aimleap

Projects

Developed a complete web application for data scraping at JustMetrically. Coded an Android application using React Native for custom sorting of scraped products for an Amazon seller in Argentina. Also developed a web-based Flask application. Coded and maintained a multi-million dollar revenue application for Sataware (ClassyCompanies). Created an image annotator web application at labeller.apiscrapy.com. Collaborated with an IIT Delhi-funded startup, Medic, to create a PyQt5 desktop application for the controlled dispensing of hazardous chemicals. Developed a Python desktop application for monitoring remote employees at 31 West Services, Bangalore. Integrated Bold Sign API into a commercial Django application to enable electronic signature functionality, ensuring a smooth document signing process for users. Developed a full-stack data scraping web app that reduced manual data entry time by 50%, enabling efﬁcient analysis of millions of records. Streamlined Facebook marketing by developing a Selenium automation project to automate messaging in groups and chats. Received the Flo Project Achievement Award for successfully scraping reviews data from multiple e-commerce platforms, overcoming challenges like captchas and anti-scraping techniques.

Led the completion of the Automated TV App Project, improving team efﬁciency and formatting over 2 million data points into JSON ﬁles. Developed the AI Labeller Web App, receiving positive feedback on design and functionality, and implemented robust algorithms for efﬁcient data labeling. Conducted extensive product data scraping from platforms like Shein.com and others, overcoming IP blocking and extracting business information from databases with millions of entries. Scraped data for horse betting analysis, providing insights for informed decisions. Developed a fully automated E-commerce data scraper and managed cron jobs at JustMetrically. Coded a PyQt5 desktop application for LinkedIn scraping and data upload to Google Sheets. Scraped various food delivery apps using Appium for mobile scraping. Utilized backend APIs and deployed Selenium Grid infrastructure for efﬁcient scraping of Swiggy, Flipkart, and other inventory e-commerce data. Sealking – Developed a React and Django application for machine learning-based model applications. DegeneratesOdds – Developed a React and Django application for betting analysis. dev-user.foreoptics.com – Developed a Next.js frontend and NestJS backend application for supply chain and DAM score calculations.
